scope: Independent DOM/IndexedDB/engine tests; not actual Chrome acceptance

results.name: additive IDB v1->v2 migration preserves legacy capture bytes, receipt and identity
explicit DOM snapshot makes no fetch, deduplicates URLs, resolves srcset and data-src placeholders
unknown-size filtering stays explicit; width and format filters work without probing images
retaining unknown dimensions cannot bypass a known width or height minimum
serial pipeline acknowledges each item, isolates 403 and reuses actual content identity
failed retry keeps the same capture identity and never resends already successful items
cancel does not start later items and confirms the already submitted item
cancel after a lost committed response uses read-only receipt lookup and starts no next import
read-only reconciliation of an uncommitted cancelled item never starts it
worker restart recovers a committed sending item by receipt without creating a replacement
destination invalidation pauses before any next item; explicit reselect preserves the item and forks only its attempted operation
metadata headers omit original buffers and batch selection is durably assigned before the first read
deselecting a paused unstarted item prevents it being sent after continue
raw pending-byte budget pauses before downloading another original
